# AI Gateway v0.2.0

This release expands the gateway into a production-oriented inference and
management platform while tightening accounting, isolation, and failure
handling across the request lifecycle.

## Highlights

- Correct and overflow-safe token admission, budget reservation, and billing,
  including tool-schema context, provider-reported usage, cache usage, hosted
  tools, images, audio, video, fine-tuning, and background jobs.
- Bounded memory caches, rate-limit state, affinity, lifecycle deduplication,
  and durable outbox paths for accounting that must survive process failure.
- Credential-, user-, deployment-, and effective-policy-aware cache and resource
  isolation, with owner checks on persisted files and asynchronous resources.
- Expanded inference APIs covering Chat Completions, Responses and lifecycle
  operations, Messages and token counting, GenerateContent, embeddings, rerank,
  images, audio, realtime sessions, video jobs, OCR, batches, fine-tuning,
  search, vector stores, RAG, skills, MCP, A2A, assistants, and sandbox execution.
- Capability-checked native adapters and workload identities for major cloud and
  model providers, including managed Vertex Gemini chat and text embeddings.
- Custom anonymization profiles backed by the active rule inventory, composable
  policy scopes, output scanning, monitoring, and fail-closed validation.
- A substantially expanded administration UI for providers, deployments,
  credentials, model groups, identities, budgets, guardrails, usage, logs, MCP,
  projects, access groups, skills, and operational diagnostics.
- Reliable UI totals, partial endpoint failure handling, stale-request
  protection, keyboard-safe modal forms, valid CSV export, and content-hashed
  static assets.
- Required PostgreSQL integration coverage in CI alongside race-tested Go
  services, OpenAPI validation, UI tests, Helm rendering, and container builds.

## Release artifacts

The release workflow publishes multi-architecture service images and signed
provenance to GHCR. Versioned Helm charts and packaged chart archives are
attached to this GitHub release.

## Upgrade notes

Review the component configuration and database migrations before upgrading.
Install or upgrade the gateway and supporting service charts with the same
release version so their internal contracts remain aligned.
